question: Estimate the number of doctors that need to be on Practo / Apollo247 to serve daily online consultation demand.
idealClarificationQuestions: Active monthly doctors (took at least 5 consultations)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Daily consultation demand / consultations per doctor per day.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total online consultations daily India (across Practo, Apollo247, Tata Health, 1mg, MedibuddyJeena): ~500K-700K consultations/day.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average online consult: ~10-15 mins (faster than offline; many follow-ups).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Doctors needed: 175K / 16 = ~11,000 active daily consulting doctors.
